title: Cold Brew Sleep Myth

scenes.text: Does a 16‑oz cold brew after 5 PM ruin sleep?
People assume any coffee after early evening automatically disrupts sleep.
scenes.label: All evening coffee harms sleep
scenes.query: person drinking coffee at night illustration

scenes.text: Caffeine’s impact depends on total intake and individual sensitivity; 16 oz may contain 150‑200 mg, which can affect sleep if consumed within six hours for most adults.
scenes.label: Timing and dose matter

scenes.text: If you need evening caffeine, limit to 100 mg and finish at least 4‑5 hours before bed.
scenes.label: Limit & schedule

scenes.text: Follow if your body is worth 60 seconds a day.

description: Explore why not all late‑day coffee is equal and how to enjoy it without sabotaging sleep. Simple adjustments, better rest.
